ne0a9d37ab9.headline: Warning to drivers as petrol prices hit seven month high
ne0a9d37ab9.summary: The AA said petrol at UK forecourts averages 136.2p per litre and diesel 144.6p. Higher pump prices raise fuel costs for drivers and businesses.
ne0a9d37ab9.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs, consumer inflation and the outlook for UK household spending. Retail fuel prices track wholesale crude and refined product costs.

n6cb64ed7c9.headline: Gas prices up $3.06, diesel down $4.50 - Jamaica Observer
n6cb64ed7c9.summary: Petrojam ex-refinery costs point to higher gasoline prices from November 20, with 90-octane at $162.03 per litre. Automotive diesel will fall by $4.50 to $168.75 per litre.
n6cb64ed7c9.why: Refined fuel prices pass through to transport and power costs, affecting inflation and household budgets in Jamaica.

nd9c5ce1fb5.headline: Thousands of Tunisian doctors strike, say health system close to collapse
nd9c5ce1fb5.summary: Thousands of young doctors went on strike across Tunisia to demand higher pay and warn the health system is close to collapse. The strike is part of wider social unrest linked to an economic crisis.
nd9c5ce1fb5.why: Tunisia faces a deep economic crisis and public-finance strain, which affects its sovereign credit and the investment climate.

n5bc6246851.headline: Forex: $161.21 to one US dollar - Jamaica Observer
n5bc6246851.summary: The US dollar ended trading in Jamaica at 161.21 on Wednesday, November 19, down 75 cents, according to the Bank of Jamaica. The Canadian dollar and pound also weakened against the Jamaican dollar.
n5bc6246851.why: The Jamaican dollar's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the value of remittances and foreign earnings for Jamaican businesses.

n2afa11b7fe.headline: Inside The 2026 Budget, The Numbers, And The Nation’s Uneasy Recovery
n2afa11b7fe.summary: Finance Minister Cassiel Ato Forson presented Ghana's 2026 Budget to Parliament on November 13, 2025. The source describes the nation's recovery as uneasy.
n2afa11b7fe.why: A national budget sets government spending, revenue and borrowing plans, which influence sovereign debt, the currency and investor confidence in the country.

n9c9eba8005.headline: Damage from Hurricane Melissa now put at US$8.8 billion - Jamaica Observer
n9c9eba8005.summary: The World Bank put damage from Hurricane Melissa, which struck Jamaica's southwestern coast on October 28, at US$8.8 billion. The estimate covers buildings, infrastructure and agriculture.
n9c9eba8005.why: Large disaster losses weigh on public finances and growth, and they shape reconstruction financing from multilateral lenders and insurers.

n742ef480dc.headline: CDB issues inaugural sustainable bond in Swiss market - Jamaica Observer
n742ef480dc.summary: The Caribbean Development Bank raised 100 million Swiss francs in a five-year sustainable bond with a 0.59 per cent coupon. The deal, its first under a new framework, drew strong demand and priced at the top of its guidance.
n742ef480dc.why: Development bank bonds fund public projects and are watched by fixed-income investors as a gauge of demand for sustainable debt.

n2d60b448e0.headline: Hurricane Melissa Leaves Jamaica With Estimated US$8.8B in Damage
n2d60b448e0.summary: Jamaica is facing its most expensive natural disaster on record after Hurricane Melissa caused an estimated US$8.8 billion in physical damage.
n2d60b448e0.why: Large disaster losses can strain a small economy's public finances, reconstruction spending and insurance markets, which affects sovereign debt and investor sentiment toward the island.

nebe07ff7f6.headline: Bulgaria extends New Year public holidays because of transition to euro
nebe07ff7f6.summary: Bulgaria's Cabinet agreed that December 31, 2025 and January 2, 2026 will be one-off public holidays, linked to the country's transition to the euro, Finance Minister Temenuzhka Petkova said.
nebe07ff7f6.why: Bulgaria's adoption of the euro changes its currency, monetary policy framework and banking system, affecting businesses and investors exposed to the country.

n673a81ad58.headline: Brazil Eyes New Crypto Tax for International Transfers
n673a81ad58.summary: Brazil is considering taxing cryptocurrency used in cross-border payments as authorities explore new rules to improve financial oversight.
n673a81ad58.why: Tax and reporting rules for crypto affect how digital assets are used in payments and how exchanges operate in Brazil, one of Latin America's largest economies.

n41cef568e1.headline: DPDP Rules: How Section 16 Governs Data Transfers Abroad
n41cef568e1.summary: India's DPDP Rules reshape cross-border data transfers, with Section 16 and Rule 15 governing how data can be shared abroad. The rules affect companies, users and international data sharing.
n41cef568e1.why: India's data protection framework determines compliance obligations for technology firms and multinationals handling personal data in India.

n1d5ed136e2.headline: ‘Difficult news’ for homeowners as house price growth slows
n1d5ed136e2.summary: The average UK house price is now around £272,000, the Office for National Statistics said. House price growth has slowed.
n1d5ed136e2.why: UK house prices influence mortgage lending, household wealth and consumer spending, and they are a key input for Bank of England policy.

n4eb055f54e.headline: Svyrydenko discusses with IMF mission new Extended Fund Facility for 2026-2029
n4eb055f54e.summary: Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko discussed a new Extended Fund Facility for 2026-2029 with the IMF mission led by Gavin Gray. The programme is being negotiated with the Fund.
n4eb055f54e.why: The IMF Extended Fund Facility is a multi-year lending programme that supports a country's finances and can unlock other official and private financing.

n97c6e45d53.headline: Nigeria: After Winning Two Oil Blocks in 2024, Total Signals Interest in Fresh Licensing Round
n97c6e45d53.summary: TotalEnergies, which won two oil and gas blocks in last year's mini-bid round, has signalled strong interest in Nigeria's 2025 licensing round, scheduled to start December 1.
n97c6e45d53.why: TotalEnergies is a major French integrated energy company, and licensing rounds determine which firms gain access to new upstream acreage.

n4559fdd0f4.summary: Meta has successfully defended itself against the US Federal Trade Commission in an antitrust case. The ruling is described as historic.

naa9bea907a.headline: Ukraine's PM, IMF aim to pass 2026 state budget by Dec 2

n44cc9d3701.headline: Emirates, Air Canada extend codeshare partnership until 2032
n44cc9d3701.summary: Emirates and Air Canada have extended their codeshare partnership until 2032. The carriers are also exploring a joint cargo project to support the global movement of goods.

ne2ad793e77.summary: UK inflation has fallen to its lowest level since June as gas and electricity price rises eased. The drop comes ahead of the Budget and may lead to lower mortgage rates soon.
